manual.title: Hook path values enter JavaScript source without data encoding
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: A tool file_path or workspace path contains a quote/control sequence; the hook interpolates it into node -e before its intended validation.
manual.impact: A quote can break parsing and trigger a permissive fallback in tdd-enforce; a crafted path can change the JavaScript program executed with hook privileges.
manual.recommendation: Pass paths through argv or dedicated environment variables and use a literal script/heredoc. Add harmless quote/newline/path and fail-closed negative tests in a separate child.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.

manual.title: MCP allowed-root checks do not resolve filesystem links
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: A caller can select or place a symlink below the allowed root/session root that resolves outside it; OS permissions still govern the destination.
manual.impact: Lexical path.resolve/path.relative checks accept the in-root spelling while Git or file streams follow links; repository operations or session reads can escape the intended boundary. Session workspace metadata is an additional check but does not establish physical containment.
manual.recommendation: Canonicalize existing roots/targets, verify physical containment and define safe creation/TOCTOU handling. Add symlink/junction/sibling-prefix cases without reading real private files.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.

manual.title: NotebookLM launcher resolves an unversioned external package
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: A fresh or refreshed uvx resolution occurs and registry/network/cache state supplies a new package version.
manual.impact: The executable dependency can change independently of the reviewed repository, weakening provenance and reproducibility; no compromise is claimed.
manual.recommendation: Pin a reviewed package version and acquisition digest/lock; separate provisioning from normal launcher execution and document updates.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.

manual.title: MCP installer substitutions are not TOML string encoding
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: An installation path or configurable value contains TOML-significant quotes/newlines; a user or local actor controls that value.
manual.impact: Literal replacement into quoted config can corrupt the document or introduce unintended config entries. This is a local setup boundary, not a demonstrated remote exploit.
manual.recommendation: Render values with a TOML-aware encoder, validate the final document and preserve prior config on error. Include quote/backslash/newline cases for both shell and PowerShell adapters.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.

manual.title: GitLab host selection can validate a different URL from the operation
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: A configured remote has different fetch and push hosts, with at least one matching the allowed host; caller can influence repository remote configuration.
manual.impact: selectRemoteDetails chooses a matching candidate from either direction, while pull uses the fetch URL and push uses the push URL. A host check can therefore accept the wrong operation endpoint.
manual.recommendation: Validate the effective URL for the requested direction, including configured multiple push URLs; add distinct fetch/push-host tests.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.

manual.title: Spec-reference containment accepts sibling prefix paths
manual.evidence_basis: Static source inspection; target programs and exploit paths were not executed.
manual.preconditions: An artifact-controlled reference resolves to a sibling whose absolute path starts with the project-root string.
manual.impact: startsWith(projectRoot) without a separator boundary accepts a sibling such as project-extra. SDD may read an out-of-project spec; the change validator performs an existence check rather than proving containment.
manual.recommendation: Use a shared separator-aware/realpath containment contract as appropriate, with sibling-prefix, parent-traversal, symlink and valid-child tests. Preserve validator read-only behavior.
manual.rationale: Static source flow supports the stated risk under the recorded preconditions. Remediation is outside this evidence-only work item; no runtime exploit claim or risk waiver.
